title: Talking Weapon Implanted Memories
description: Accepts both the new Studio envelope object and the current legacy runtime top-level array format.

oneOf.description: Legacy runtime format currently consumed by LTMStorage.

id.description: Optional stable UUID. Runtime may generate one if omitted.

enabled.description: Optional Studio flag for disabling a memory without deleting it.

description.description: The actual memory text injected into long-term memory.

semantic_time_tag.description: Optional time-related custom tag used as a narrative time anchor. It participates in associative memory edges and prompt time semantics, but is kept out of the normal detail_tags cue pool.

detail_tags.description: Specific or generic detail tags attached to this memory.

occurred_day_index.description: Optional long-lived day anchor (1-based). Preferred over raw occurred_game_time for newly authored memories.

occurred_time_of_day_tick.description: Optional within-day tick anchor. Fill together with occurred_day_index when a memory needs a concrete in-world time anchor.

occurred_game_time.description: Legacy compatibility field for absolute in-game ticks. New authored data should prefer occurred_day_index + occurred_time_of_day_tick.

time_label.description: Compatibility text anchor currently consumed by runtime. Studio may derive it from semantic_time_tag.

notes.description: Editor-facing note, not injected to runtime memory text.
